summary: The cap estimate is valid in all threshold regimes, its applications to the middle and outer slices preserve the required inequalities, and the halfspace normal form yields (1), including all boundary cases t=0 and t=1. Condition (2) correctly implies the stated 2T/9 bound. The rectangle example is compatible and balanced, all areas, centroids, inradii, and numerical comparisons are correct, and it strictly separates the new certificate from both components of the predecessor bound.
